opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and order number before sharing account data, and the caller supplied both, so verification was done correctly.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €75.00 comes back?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the refund issue accurately and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, so the stated 10 to 14 days and the 'week or two' timeline are wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day it's paid. Is there anything else I can help you with?
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred and no damaged item or bank dispute was involved, so no required process step applied; the agent did not need to ask for a photo or request permission to hold.

communication.quote: I understand, it's worrying when money is outstanding. Let me check.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's worry, which meets the communication standard.

closing.quote: Thanks for calling, Ahmed, have a good afternoon.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the next step was described inaccurately, so the confirmation of what happens next is unreliable; the agent should confirm the correct 5-working-day timeline before closing.
